semantics: Immutable scoped nodes, bounded demand reads, COW point paths, sorted streaming construction, authenticated sequence floors, relative truncation range minima and subtree truncation. Referenced entry counts include sequence-hidden leaves. Caller must seal roots and pin lifetime; roots are not independent byte availability, ownership or deletion capabilities.
install_verification: Every successful install compares a bounded readback to the exact generated body, including ignored/deleted/altered trigger cases and ignored insertion with an exact preexisting node. Missing/type/hash/size/body/stat failures are corruption, not absent patches; SQL authorization/I/O failures retain their cause. Returned roots require caller commit with its own intent.
paging: Volatile walk/prune cursors are depth/fanout bounded and poisoned after partial failure/cancellation. Pruning publishes a root only on completion and permits staging commits between pages. Rollback/failed page commit requires restarting from the pinned source. Node read/install budget 1..256 excludes one separately counted verification SELECT per install; no module collector or root registry exists.
